name: Medical devices and disposables
note: For medical devices and disposables, CBP usually finds that origin is conferred where the primary functional component, such as the stainless steel needle cannula, syringe barrel or bulb, main fluid chamber or tubing, forged surgical blank, or printed circuit board assembly and sensors, is made. Attaching plastic hubs, bonding connectors and clamps onto tubing, inserting plungers into barrels, putting components into blister trays, and sterilising and packing are treated as assembly that does not confer origin. Precision finishing of an imported blank was not enough in the one pool ruling on it. Origin under these rulings says nothing about regulatory clearance or approval. Written from 26 CBP substantial-transformation rulings outside the dev and held-out splits (D138), with four rulings from the train and other pools added in version 2 (D782); every new citation was read against its facts and held origin. Costs are illustrative defaults; users edit them.

groups.name: Needle cannula or metal blank
operations: roll, laser-weld, and cold-draw stainless steel strip into hollow needle tubing
cut stainless steel tubing to length and bevel, grind, or sharpen the needle tip
temper, anneal, electropolish, and bend stainless steel cannulae to fixed angles
hot-forge and anneal stainless steel into the distinctive shape of surgical forceps

precedent.note: CBP held that manufacturing the sharpened or pre-processed stainless steel cannula or hot-forged surgical blank confers origin on needles, tips, and forceps (H322967, N343712, N343771, N348317, N361712), and dental tips took the origin of their first, pre-bent cannula (N343773), though a pre-made needle alone did not determine origin when combined with locally molded and assembled syringe parts (N344211, N344695). Medical drill bits took the origin of the Chinese blanks (steel rods cut and lathe-machined); grinding the cutting flutes and notching them in Ireland was not enough (N341537).

groups.name: Moulded barrels, chambers and tubing
operations: injection-mold plastic syringe barrels with integral tips, plungers, and plunger seals
print graduated volume measurement markings onto syringe barrels
injection-mold soft plastic irrigation bulbs and integral bent plastic cannula tips
manufacture drip chambers, selectable drop chambers, and filtered transfusion chambers
extrude medical-grade PVC and fluted silicone tubing for fluid administration and drainage

precedent.note: CBP looked to the country producing the core fluid-handling body, such as molded syringe parts (N343161, N344211), a soft bulb (N342838), an integral molded tip (N343775), or primary medical tubing (N348081), while finding secondary molded parts insufficient when paired with a more essential imported component (N342838, N343161). Extruding the silicone drain tube in Israel made Israel the origin of wound drains cut and assembled in India (N355983).

groups.name: PCBA and sensors
operations: populate printed circuit boards with electronic components using surface mount technology (SMT)
manufacture and assemble LED emitters and photodetectors into optical sensor arrays
produce chip-on-board (COB) modules, LCD screens, and temperature or pressure sensor movements
load firmware and perform circuit board quality control testing

precedent.note: For electronic and optical medical devices, CBP held that origin is conferred where the SMT printed circuit board assembly, electronic movement, or LED/photodetector array is manufactured (N336168, N345397, N350041); for blood pressure monitors, making the PCBA by SMT and chip-on-board, burning the firmware into it and calibrating the pressure sensor in Vietnam made Vietnam the origin (N334538).

groups.name: Hubs, clamps and housings
operations: injection-mold plastic needle hubs, sheaths, protective caps, and luer connectors
manufacture roller clamps, pinch clamps, slide clamps, spikes, and Y-injection sites
produce plastic enclosures, top and bottom guides, foam laminates, adhesive tapes, and cords
extrude and coat brush fibers for dental applicator tips

precedent.note: CBP found that sourcing minor connecting or housing parts such as plastic hubs, sheaths, clamps, luer locks, cords, brush fibers, outer enclosures or a blood pressure cuff does not confer origin on the finished device (H322967, N334538, N336168, N343771, N343774, N348081, N349038).

groups.name: Sterilisation and sterile packing
operations: place devices in blister trays or pouches and seal them with Tyvek lids
sterilise packed devices with ethylene oxide or gamma radiation, then release them

precedent.note: Packing and sterilising did not change origin: safety needles packed and sterilised in the United States kept their needles' origin (H322967), and drill bits packed and sterilised in Ireland stayed Chinese (N341537).

groups.name: Final assembly
operations: glue or attach plastic hubs and protective caps onto stainless steel needles and cannulae
insert plungers with gaskets into syringe barrels and screw hubbed needles onto syringe tips
solvent-bond medical tubing to drip chambers, spikes, Y-sites, and luer connectors in a cleanroom
assemble sensor arrays, PCBs, displays, and batteries into plastic housings or adhesive foam pads
cut extruded tubing to length and assemble drains, connectors and bulbs

precedent.note: CBP held that gluing hubs to needles, bonding tubing, assembling syringe components, and kit packaging do not confer origin on their own (H322967, N336168, N340345, N343712, N348081, N357919), nor cutting imported drain tubes and assembling drains (N355983), conferring origin only when combined with molding core parts or complex assembly (H339462, N344211, N344695).
